metadata.title: Robot SF three-width doorway S30/H600 evaluation slice
metadata.description: Three-width doorway slice of the sealed Robot SF 0.0.8 evaluation: 14 planner arms, widths 2.2/2.8/3.6 m, and 30 seeds at requested horizon 600 with dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (1,260 expected episode identities). The scenario horizon cap is 400 steps. Source commit {{source_sha}}, freeze-branch base (first parent of the source commit) {{latest_main_base_commit}}, release tag {{release_tag}}, concept DOI {{concept_doi}}, and version DOI {{version_doi}} bind this slice to the main campaign freeze. This slice is reported with raw metrics only; its SNQI v2 diagnostics are advisory and not validated for this slice, and support no ranking or comparison claim.
